name: browser-probe
command: from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright; import os; p=sync_playwright().start(); b=p.chromium.launch(headless=True, executable_path=os.environ["HATCH_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE"], args=["--no-sandbox", "--disable-dev-shm-usage"]); print("Actual Chromium:", b.version); page=b.new_page(); page.set_content("<title>Hatch baseline browser probe</title>"); print("Page title:",page.title()); b.close(); p.stop()
